verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing says its business account can earn 'up to 3.70%†', with banking offered as part of the platform. That suggests yield on operating cash held in the Brex account itself, without moving funds to another institution. The only evidence is one footnoted marketing line, with no documentation of how the yield works, its eligibility conditions, or what the dagger caveat covers. Missing for 10: first-party docs on the treasury/yield mechanism and eligibility, the terms behind the footnote, whether operating balances earn yield automatically versus via a separate treasury product, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
